d:
Racism against Indians is rising online—but how much of what we see is actually real?
In this video, Abhi and Niyu investigate how AI-generated videos, misleading edits and coordinated social media campaigns can create negative stereotypes about India and influence how Indians are perceived around the world. We explore how viral content spreads, how online narratives can turn into real-world racism, and why India's global image matters far beyond social media.
